{{Quote|I've read about them. Once a month they perform here on Cloud City in what has to be the most terrific exhibition in this spiral arm. Amazing creatures&mdash;and the riders, too.|Jacen Solo|<ref name="SWG">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Trouble on Cloud City]]''</ref>}}
'''Sky rodeos''' were [[Standard month/Legends|monthly]] spectacles performed by the [[Thranta Rider]]s of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
